Multi-alignment strategy adapts to constrained options as traditional Gulf partnerships fracture and regional polarization eliminates hedging space.

story_clusters.headline: Abdullah bin Zayed conducts diplomatic outreach with multiple foreign officials

story_clusters.headline: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque achieves record visitor numbers in 2025

story_clusters.headline: UAE President confers honor on Chinese Ambassador and meets Italian President

Separately, the UAE President held talks with Italian President Sergio Mattarella in Abu Dhabi.

story_clusters.headline: Central Bank of UAE maintains interest rates at 3.65%

story_clusters.headline: GCC launches joint military exercise including UAE participation

story_clusters.headline: UAE concludes 10-year military mission in Yemen
